items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: when I did Rosemary Clooney with Sam Noto, the two of us with Joe Coccuzo and all the cats from New York, we did it at the Art Park

ctx.x: That’s a time you’ll never forget in your life. Never, ever. I was high as a kite. I felt extraordinarily good. And it was difficult, like backing up Ella, Nancy Wilson, a couple of other people, there was those points in time when you get up to blow and — not that long ago, five years ago, when I did Rosemary Clooney with Sam Noto, the two of us with Joe Coccuzo and all the cats from New York, we did it at the Art Park, and I was on tenor on that gig and we were in a rehearsal and we started to blow and read…
